record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: For a cuspidal automorphic representation Π of GL_n(A_E) and an n-dimensional skew-Hermitian space V over the global field E, prove the global twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad criterion that the global period integral P_V is nonzero exactly when every local Hom-space Hom_{U(V_v)}(Π_v, ω_{V_v,ψ_v,μ_v}) is nonzero and the central L-value L(1/2, Π × σΠ∨ × μ^{-1}) is nonzero, and prove that whenever this central L-value is nonzero there is a unique skew-Hermitian space V of dimension n for which P_V is nonzero.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.2. In the above setting, in particular for V a skew-Hermitian space over a global field E, the global period integral PV is nonzero if and only if the following two conditions hold ... (a) For all places v of F, HomU(Vv)(Πv, ωVv,ψv,µv) ̸= 0. (b) L(1/2, Π × σΠ∨ × µ−1) ̸= 0. Further, for a cuspidal automorphic representation Π of GLn(AE), if L(1/2, Π × σΠ∨ × µ−1) ̸= 0, then there exists a unique skew-Hermitian space V of dimension n over E such that the global period integral PV is nonzero.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E/F$ be a quadratic extension of number fields with nontrivial Galois automorphism $\sigma$, and let $\mathbb{A}=\mathbb{A}_F$, $\mathbb{A}_E$ denote the corresponding adèle rings. Fix a nontrivial additive character $\psi:F\backslash\mathbb{A}\to\mathbb{C}^\times$ and a Hecke character $\mu:E^\times\backslash\mathbb{A}_E^\times\to\mathbb{C}^\times$ whose restriction to $\mathbb{A}^\times$ equals the quadratic character associated with $E/F$ by class field theory.

Let $V$ be an $n$-dimensional non-degenerate skew-Hermitian space over $E$ with unitary group $U(V)$, and for each place $v$ let $\omega_{V_v,\psi_v,\mu_v}$ denote the Weil representation of $U(V_v)$ on $V\otimes_F F_v$ determined by $(\psi_v,\mu_v)$. Let $\Pi$ be an irreducible cuspidal automorphic representation of $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{A}_E)$, and let $\sigma\Pi^\vee$ denote the conjugate contragredient of $\Pi$. For a skew-Hermitian space $V$ as above, let $P_V$ denote the global twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad period integral associated with $(\Pi,V,\mu,\psi)$ (an explicit unitary–group period attached to descents of $\Pi$ twisted by the Weil representation).

Prove the following two assertions:

(i) The period $P_V$ is not identically zero on the automorphic realization of $\Pi$-descent if and only if both
  (a) $\mathrm{Hom}_{U(V_v)}(\Pi_v,\omega_{V_v,\psi_v,\mu_v})\neq 0$ for every place $v$ of $F$, and
  (b) the central $L$-value $L(\tfrac12,\Pi\times\sigma\Pi^\vee\times\mu^{-1})$ is nonzero.

(ii) Whenever $L(\tfrac12,\Pi\times\sigma\Pi^\vee\times\mu^{-1})\neq 0$, there exists a unique $n$-dimensional skew-Hermitian space $V$ over $E$ (up to isomorphism) for which $P_V$ is nonzero.
artifact.status_search_result: The twisted GGP conjecture for skew-Hermitian unitary groups remains open in full generality. Partial progress exists: the (untwisted) Fourier–Jacobi case has been established under tempered/local conditions by Liu, Xue, and others via relative trace formula and theta correspondence methods, and the twisted GGP conjecture has been verified for certain tempered L-packets. No proof of the full global twisted conjecture or of the uniqueness statement in arbitrary cuspidal generality appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for certain tempered L-packets
status_evidence.snippet: A twisted version of the Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture... has been investigated using the theta correspondence, establishing some special cases.
status_evidence.claim: Only special tempered cases of the twisted GGP conjecture are currently known.

status_evidence.title: The global Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for Fourier–Jacobi periods on unitary groups I
status_evidence.snippet: Proof strategy via relative trace formulae for Fourier–Jacobi periods on unitary groups.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to address the skew-Hermitian/Fourier–Jacobi GGP conjecture, indicating it is not fully settled.

status_evidence.title: Twisted GGP Problems and Conjectures (lecture notes)
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is stated as an open problem.
